intro: Plantation Edge I & II is an HDB project in Tengah. The name records two parts, I and II. Our file notes that the Plantation Edge phases have different launch waiting times; we will not invent which phase is shorter, and we will not invent a typologies split or a key-date timetable between them. Third-party completion estimates in the file have conflicted, and official HDB material has not verified a current project-wide completion or key month. This entry is not officially confirmed, so unit counts and any estimated month are left out of the facts below. If you have a key letter, use that — and check which phase it names. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Plantation Edge I & II renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Plantation Edge I & II interior
sections.text:
A first fit-out in this plantation cluster still has to work on day one: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, designed as built-in carpentry rather than as loose, flat-pack furniture. Maison can show a wide room or a closer material study, and we will draw only from your approved HDB plan. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed.

Brickland Weave and Plantation Dew are the other Tengah pages in this batch; Dew is a November 2026 launch and is not a completion guide for Edge. Plantation Creek, Garden Waterfront I & II and Plantation Verge, packed earlier, sit in the same town. Keat Hong Grange and Heart of Yew Tee are nearby Choa Chu Kang links. We will not invent walking times to any present or future MRT station, and we will not copy a date from one Tengah page to another.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan, the phase if it is named on your documents, and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
